name: Dread-Fleet Buccaneers
identity: Sky-pirates with skiffs, frigates and boarding parties. Skiffs slip 3″ after firing and crews leap off them; killing on objectives or killing Leaders earns Plunder CP for yourself (never taken from the opponent).

rules.name: Plunder & Cannonades
rules.description: Plunder: once per round, when you destroy an enemy unit that was within 3″ of an objective, or an enemy Leader, gain 1 CP (your own pool cap still applies). Cannonades: [FLY] or [TRANSPORT] units may make a free 3″ move after they Shoot (not into engagement).

rules.name: Gamble — Ram & Board
rules.description: A [TRANSPORT] skiff may Charge; units aboard may disembark within 3″ of it after the Charge and Charge the same target in their own activation this round. The skiff suffers D3 Fatal Wounds. (Risk: durability.)

detachments.name: Sky-Raiders
detachments.playstyle: Skiffs and frigates darting in and out.

rules.name: Hit-and-Run
rules.description: Cannonades slip is 4″ and may be made after a Fight action that destroyed the enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Cut and Run
stratagems.effect: It may Fall Back and still Shoot.

stratagems.name: Smoke on the Water
stratagems.effect: One skiff counts as [STEALTH] until the End of Round.
